title: rosa agrestis var. mentita
intro: Rosa agrestis var. mentita, commonly known as wild rose, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its potential in alleviating anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders. The health benefits of Rosa agrestis var. mentita are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include being a sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
